title: Eric's portrait: original style or 734
question: You said the old portraits matched the cast better. This is the original approved portrait with his eyes opened and the red rim removed. Use this set, or keep 734?

options.label: Original style, eyes open (neutral 831 at 0.6, surprised 831, tired 833)
options.note: Beard drawn a little fuller; cream highlights in the hair remain

decision: No: wanted the old, ancient first ones that look like anime figures, not this graphic-novel style
